proposal.summary: ledger-flow-ts is a TypeScript settlement and ledger-flow library (single node project, 21 parsed TS files, 0 diagnostics). It models a financial settlement pipeline: ordered message/batch delivery with per-account lanes and idempotent commits, a hash-chained ledger journal with cutoff-calendar business-day scheduling, netting/fee planning, a scenario execution engine that compiles and runs settlement scenarios with retries and blocked accounts, codec/parsing utilities for audit names, market memos and route codes, plus receipt reconciliation and settlement telemetry. Each source module exposes a class plus typed input/inspection interfaces and follows a consistent 'evaluate*Policies' inspection pattern. Cross-module coupling is low; most source files are standalone with no imports, and tests import source modules via unresolved .js specifiers (TS source compiled to JS at runtime). Analysis is structural (tree-sitter); semantic resolution of test imports and a few internal exports (ReceiptReconcilerRecord, RouteCodeParserRecord) is unresolved.

modules.name: Partitioned Inbox Delivery Engine
modules.purpose: Core ordered, at-least-once message delivery with gap handling and retention.
modules.description: Concurrent, lane-partitioned inbox that accepts StreamMessage records, validates them, orders delivery by per-lane sequence, waits on missing predecessors, rejects duplicate identities/positions, evicts completed identities at retention capacity, supports explicit forget of old records, and exposes snapshots of lane state (waiting sequences, active identities). Backed by Arc/Mutex/Condvar synchronization.

modules.name: Sequence Ledger
modules.purpose: Ordering and gap bookkeeping for stream messages.
modules.description: Tracks per-stream observed sequence positions, contiguous high-water marks, missing gaps, duplicate counts, and supports pruning observed-through points. Provides SequenceObservation and SequenceSnapshot views.

modules.name: Retrying Payout Book
modules.purpose: Durable payout tracking with retry and completion bookkeeping.
modules.description: Records payout requests with account/currency/fingerprint validation, tracks retry batches and completion receipts with timestamps, supports forgetting old batches, and exposes PayoutBookSnapshot of completed/joined/replayed batch counts. Synchronized via Arc/Mutex/Condvar.

modules.name: Shutdown Drain Ledger
modules.purpose: Graceful shutdown drain and persistence accounting.
modules.description: Tracks pending records (identity, partition, sequence, payload) during shutdown drain, records persisted/failed-write counts, and exposes ShutdownSnapshot plus finish/pending_records operations. Synchronized via Mutex/Condvar.

modules.name: Account Partitioner
modules.purpose: Stable account-to-partition routing and rebalancing analysis.
modules.description: Deterministic salted assignment of accounts to a fixed number of partitions, with balance reporting (counts, average, empty partitions) and topology comparison to detect moved accounts between two partitioner configurations.

modules.name: Receipt Codec
modules.purpose: Wire-format serialization and integrity for receipt envelopes.
modules.description: Binary encode/decode of ReceiptEnvelope (account, receipt, committed_millis, attributes) with version inspection, envelope validation, size limits, and CRC-32C corruption/truncation detection.

modules.name: Quote Token Parser
modules.purpose: Command-line parsing for stream control commands.
modules.description: Tokenizes and parses command text into ParsedCommand (verb, positional args, flags, assignments) with quote/escape handling, and renders tokens back to text.

modules.name: Retry Schedule
modules.purpose: Backoff and retry timing policy.
modules.description: Computes retry delay sequences from base/maximum durations, jitter fraction, and seed; validates parameters; provides budget and attempts-within helpers.

modules.name: Library Public API Facade
modules.purpose: Single public entry point for the account-stream-rs library.
modules.description: Crate root that re-exports the public API of every source module: AccountPartitioner/PartitionBalance, QuoteTokenParser/ParsedCommand, ReceiptCodec/ReceiptEnvelope, RetrySchedule, RetryingPayoutBook types, PartitionedInbox types, SequenceLedger types, and ShutdownLedger types.

modules.name: Utility Component Tests
modules.purpose: Verify AccountPartitioner, QuoteTokenParser, ReceiptCodec, and RetrySchedule behavior.
modules.description: Unit tests for the utility/shared-contract components: deterministic salted account partitioning, partition topology movement, quote/escape/assignment command parsing, receipt codec corruption/truncation detection and envelope/size validation, and retry-schedule parameter rejection.

modules.name: Inbox Delivery Tests
modules.purpose: Verify ordered delivery, deduplication, and failure semantics of the partitioned inbox.
modules.description: Concurrency and delivery tests for PartitionedInbox: handler failure/retry, missing-predecessor timeout, concurrent duplicate joins running side effects once, identity reuse rejection, close semantics, and malformed-message validation.

modules.name: Inbox Retention Tests
modules.purpose: Verify retention eviction, explicit forget, and snapshot behavior of the partitioned inbox.
modules.description: Retention and snapshot tests for PartitionedInbox: completion-retention eviction of oldest identity at capacity, explicit forget of records older than a threshold, and snapshots showing waiting sequences and active identities.

proposal.summary: The selected project is a Rust library crate (crate name `account-stream-rs`, imported as `account_stream_rs`) that models a concurrent account-stream processing system. Its responsibilities span: (1) a partitioned, lane-based inbox that delivers ordered stream messages with sequence-gap waiting, duplicate/identity rejection, retention eviction, and snapshotting; (2) a per-stream sequence ledger that tracks observed positions, gaps, duplicates, and pruning; (3) a retrying payout book that records payouts, retry batches, receipts, and completion snapshots; (4) a shutdown ledger that drains pending records with persistence tracking; (5) deterministic salted account-to-partition assignment with topology comparison; (6) a binary receipt codec with CRC-32C integrity; (7) a quote-aware command tokenizer/parser; and (8) a retry-delay schedule generator. `src/lib.rs` is the public API facade re-exporting all modules. The crate depends only on the Rust standard library (std::collections, std::sync, std::time, std::thread, std::fmt). Analysis limitations: the tree-sitter provider reports all intra-crate `pub use`/`pub fn` references as 'unresolved' imports (evidenceLevel unresolved) even though they are internal re-exports, so the dependency graph understates internal coupling; the full symbol inventory (336 symbols) and several file structures were truncated, and the query budget was exhausted before inspecting tests/sequence_and_payout.rs, tests/shutdown_drain.rs, and tests/stream_scenarios.rs in detail, so those files are assigned by import evidence only.
